source: Scene-locked vertical (Instagram) FEATURE-PROMO reel for the Evidence Library hub (evidence-library.html + ev-s1..ev-s8 fragments + ev-m-* mastery pages + library/*). Counts measured 2026-09-25 from the repo: 8 tab buttons; 89 cards = 80 argument cards + 9 conversion stories (ev-s7); 96 cited deep dives = the generated trust figure (index.html trust strip / editorial-standards). Features traced to the pages: plain English -> 'The Case, Plainly' -> Pro Deep Dive tiers; 'Research the argument, premise by premise' tap-to-open section; Ask AI Tutor + Teach me this (per the gated tutors-instagram reel); Mastery Tracks (labelled Pro on the pages, Pro launching soon, currently open - kicker deliberately omits PRO) with four checkpoints understand/explain/drill/defend, Explain It Back AI scoring (/api/tutor), flashcards, a pre-written skeptic objection; tiers + tap-to-open claimed only for ARGUMENT cards (ev-s7 stories have none); 96 essays are site-wide (cards link 78); pocket cards on 78 of 80 cards (hence 'an argument'); pocket-card generator; Debate Arena link. voiceover: This is the Evidence Library on Apologia Daily — the case for the Christian faith, gathered in one place. Eight sections: God's existence, the Resurrection, Jesus, Biblical reliability, science and faith, the Trinity, conversion stories, and the Christian revolution. Eighty argument cards — plus nine conversion stories. Every argument card starts in plain English. Then the case, plainly. Then a deeper dive, with the strongest objections fairly stated and answered. Tap any line of an argument to see the evidence behind it, where it's contested, and what it honestly can — and can't — show. And across the site, ninety-six fully cited deep-dive essays — no essay is published until it clears five review stages. On every essay and card, two AI tutors. Ask AI Tutor answers your questions in plain English, grounded in the page you're reading. Teach me this helps you build the argument yourself, one question at a time. Then make it yours. Mastery Tracks take you through four checkpoints: understand it, explain it, drill it, defend it — with an AI-scored Explain It Back, flashcards, and a skeptic's objection to answer. Turn an argument into a pocket card to share, or step into the Debate Arena and practise it. Not just reading about the faith — being ready to give a reason for the hope you have, with gentleness and respect. Explore the Evidence Library at apologiadaily.com.
